To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the twist-four longitudinal structure function for the weak coupling light-front theory of a positronium like bound state has been calculated and it is related to the binding energy in the nonrelativistic limit.
the sum rule for twist-four structure functions is verified in the weak-coupling light-front QED, and that the longitudinal structure function is peaked at x =12 at fixed value Q 2 in this theory.

the sum rule for twist-four FL in weak coupling QED reduces to a relation between the kinetic and potential energies of the bound fermions, and FL is sharply peaked in the region 12 < x < 12 at fixed Q 2.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the higher-twisted structure functions in light-front QED in the weak coupling regime.
the calculation of the twist-four structure function F 2L for the positronium-like system in light-front quantum electrodynamics.
the study of the structure of a positroniumlike bound state of a fermionic constituent with a scalar boson in light-front QED, in the weak-coupling regime.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

in a weakly coupled system the fermionic twist-four structure function is related to the fermionic partonic momentum distribution, which is in turn related to the kinetic and potential energies of the fermions.

the twist four longitudinal structure functions are sensitive to the interaction between the constituents of the bound states, while the twist four transverse structure functions are sensitive not only to the interaction but also to the kinetic energy.
the twist four longitudinal structure functions are sensitive to the binding energies of the bound states, but not to the interactions between the constituents.
